caveat: All labels/failures exposed before v4 development. Shared labels are not independent replications. Scope checks use accepted sites, not possible fringe envelopes. Manual targeted locations are used only for evaluation; they do not construct filtered observations or mapping. The optional screen requires exact normalized surface and overlap with an optimal unique anchor; anchor overlap need not cover the entire word and is not correctness certification. Boundary scores retain adjudication and uncertainty; no corpus-wide accuracy or probability claim.
